A1.name: Schema & Formatting
checks: Goal regex: ^Follow these steps to perform this .* (Troubleshooting|Configuration)\.$
Action description strictly 5-7 words starting with 'It will'
Zero URL leaks (http://, https://, www., .com, .html, markdown links)

A2.name: Deeplink Validity & Auto-Action Coverage
checks: Actions with category 'auto' must have non-null actionableDeeplink
Validation deeplink populated if catalog entry contains validation
DL-DUMMY (bixby://dummy_positive) used if no catalog match with custom 5-7 word message/description

A3.name: Cache & Latency
checks: Repeat query latency p95 <= 300 ms with >= 90% cache hit

A4.name: Generalization / Unseen Scenarios
checks: Unseen scenarios (not in 20-scenario kit) produce valid non-empty responses
Actions and steps derived from new SIIS response payload

A5.name: Query Variations Diversity
checks: Strictly 8-10 unique paraphrases per query in results.jsonl
Linguistic/lexical diversity across vocabulary, sentence structure, formality

G2.failure_consequence: All live evaluation checks are skipped; automated score = 0

G4.condition: Schema validity rate across all responses

G5.condition: External URL leaks in output text
G5.failure_consequence: Direct gate failure; automated score does not count

results_jsonl.role: Pre-computed submission artifact evaluated against Gates G3, G4, G5 and Block A5

known_unknowns: Identity and requirement of Gate G1 (omitted from official FAQ table)
Exact mathematical sub-point formula within Block A1 (15 pts)
Exact mathematical formula for Block A5 lexical diversity scoring
Exact number of test requests sent by judges during live evaluation window
Whether hidden scenarios use an extended deeplink catalog beyond the 578 entries
baseline_risks: Paraphrase cache hit rate is 0% in current exact-string cache (requirement >= 80%)
POST /v1/troubleshoot is missing from app.py (returns 404 to judges)
All 20 public scenarios emit 'Adjust Display Configuration' using only 4 of 578 deeplinks
No semantic reasoning or dynamic step extraction implemented yet
